title: I 1035 potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: I 1035 potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: I 1035 potato is a potato variety. About 100 days to harvest, 24 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: I 1035 is a registered potato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1986. It takes about 100 days from planting to harvest, with 24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** about 100 days from planting to harvest.
**Yield:** 24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

I 1035 potato takes about 100 days from planting to harvest. That is 3.5 days faster than the average of the 11 potato varieties with a day count, 103.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 24 t/ha beats the average of its group, 21.79. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [late blight](/diseases/late-blight).

The pests and diseases that hit potato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have white flesh and yellow skin.
Where and when to plant I 1035 potato

It suits highland areas. Potato grows in the cool highlands of Benguet, Mountain Province and Bukidnon. Plant clean seed tubers, and pick a variety rated against late blight for the wet season. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 100 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 24 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of I 1035?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
